content.title: Joe Keery’s Djo North American tour tickets: How to grab yours before they sell out
content.text: Updated: Mar. 18, 2026, 9:41 a.m.Published: Mar. 18, 2026, 9:39 a.m.Along with supporting Tame Impala on their ongoing tour this summer, alt/indie artist Djo recently announced a handful of headlining shows.Erika Goldring/WireImageIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Breanna Manley | bmanley@al.comKnown worldwide for both his acting and music careers, Djo, otherwise known as Joe Keery, recently announced additional performance dates for the summer. While a majority of Djo’s performances this summer are in support of Tame Impala’s ongoing The Deadbeat Tour, the alternative/indie musician announced just yesterday that he plans on littering a healthy dose of North American headline tour dates throughout the summer with support from Pond, an Australian-based psychedelic rock band. Djo 2026 headline tour datesJuly 14 – Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania – Stage AE July 17 – Forest Hills, New York – Forest Hills Stadium July 21 – Portland, Maine – Thompson’s PointJuly 23 – Lewiston, New York – ArtparkJuly 31 – Richmond, Virginia – Allianz Amphitheater at RiverfrontDjo 2026 ticketsFor fans who may be missing out on the highly anticipated Tame Impala tour but are still eager for a chance to see Djo perform live, tickets for Djo’s headlining tour will be available through an artist presale starting Wednesday, March 18 at 12 p.m. local time. Additionally, public onsale tickets follow soon after on Friday, March 20 at 12 p.m. local time. Concertgoers looking to explore potential savings can check out great deals and exclusive discounts through secondary markets including Vivid Seats, StubHub, Viagogo and Seat Geek. Both Vivid Seats and Seat Geek are currently offering exclusive promo codes for customers to enjoy. First-time Vivid Seats customers can enjoy $30 off their first order of $200+ after using promo code ADVANCE30 at checkout, whereas those exploring ticket options through Seat Geek can take $5 off orders of $300+ by using promo code TAKE5 at checkout.
